name: Borderlands 4: Bounty Pack 4 - Murders & Acquisitions
storyline: Levaine, leader of the Electi, has been contacted by an unlikely group of potential allies: The Flock, a commune of pacifist Rippers who gave up violent slaughter for chill vibes. They've made camp in a polluted desert canyon known as the Toxic Scowl, but now their buzz is being harshed by The Blasphemers, an aggressive group of Rippers who have taken over a nearby Order facility.
summary: A new repeatable mission that tasks you with mediating a conflict between two rival Ripper factions in the polluted Toxic Scowl canyon. Help Levaine navigate tensions between The Flock, a pacifist commune, and The Blasphemers, an aggressive group controlling a nearby Order facility. Your choices shape which mini-boss encounters you face as you fight through contaminated salt-addled bandits to secure powerful Order technology and unlock new cosmetics, vehicle skins, and Vault Hunter gear.
